name: Shells [SUMMER OASIS LIVE] 🌟
desc:
🐚 Shells 🐚
Explore a relaxing open-world adventure where the ocean is full of hidden treasures 🌊

Collect and sell unique shells of different shapes, species, sizes, and rarities across beautiful islands 🏝️✨ Upgrade your gear and progress to find even rarer shells!

🦀 Hermit Crab Companion
Raise and upgrade your hermit crab pet to help you find more shells and even collect shells while you’re offline ⏰🐚

🌍 Open World Exploration
Freely explore an expanding world, currently spanning 9 islands, each filled with secrets to uncover.

How to Find Shells
- Click on sand to start digging
- Crawl around until you discover a shell 🐚
- When you find one, click when the bar is inside the white area
- Keep going until the progress bar is full, it’s okay to miss a few times!

Relax, explore, and become the ultimate shell collector 🌊✨
🐚 How many shells can you find? 🐚
